description.html: The SOBO SB-833 is a small sponge filter with a round sponge on a base with a clear outlet tube. It takes up little space, so it fits easily in a corner of the aquarium or behind decor. It suits nano, breeding and quarantine tanks.

A sponge filter runs on an air pump: bubbles in the tube lift the water, which draws aquarium water through the sponge. The sponge traps dirt and hosts beneficial bacteria, so the filter provides mechanical and biological filtration while adding oxygen to the water.

It needs an air pump and airline tubing, sold separately. When the bubble flow weakens, squeeze the sponge out in aquarium water during a water change, never under the tap, so the beneficial bacteria survive. A sponge filter also makes a great backup: keep it running in your aquarium and move it to a quarantine tank when needed.
